items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had Martin Banks, Virgil Jones, and Johnny Coles on trumpets.

ctx.x: Al Dailey and Virgil Jones, and whenever possible the late Alan Dawson on drums, and either Richard Davis or Bob Cunningham, someone like that on bass.
